TEXT: An elite tactical T-Doll from Griffin & Kryuger. NL Employs neurotoxin, heavy ordnance, and high-frequency strikes to decimate enemies.

Elegant and composed; a Doll brimming with confidence. She aspires to make every member of H.I.D.E. 404 into an elite. Only those who are familiar with her know the tenderness that lies behind her cold, strong-willed demeanor.

Navigating an unlit street, you come across several hooded figures in the midst of some dark ritual. As you approach, they turn to you in eerie unison. The tallest among them bares fanged teeth and extends a long, pale hand towards you. NL ~"Join~ ~us~ ~elite~ ~one,~ ~and~ ~feel~ ~the~ ~warmth~ ~of~ ~the~ ~Spire."~
